abstract: For every labeled alphabet of size q>=2, a rational generating function counts odd palindromes with adjacent unequal letters by half-length and full-alphabet subsequence-universality index. The formula yields a simple ternary specialization and sharp minimum lengths with counts of all shortest witnesses.

integrity.numeric_reproducibility: Standard-library verify.py included and executed successfully

scientific_limitations: The general palindrome midpoint criterion is established in Barker et al. (2020) and is explicitly credited. The new exact distribution relies on an additional residual-alphabet refinement and a restricted-word transfer argument. Published equivalence is not ruled out exhaustively; finite checks are not proofs of universal quantifiers.
title: Exact universality-index distribution of adjacency-distinct palindromes
